_provenance.note: Wisconsin citation authorities. The FoodShare Wisconsin Policy Handbook cites its own sections as plain decimal numbers (e.g. '4.2.1', '8.1.1.3'); this pack prefixes them 'FSH <section>' to disambiguate from other states' numbering (matching the pattern this roster already uses for Illinois' PM/WAG and Michigan's BEM/BAM prefixes).

patterns.note: FoodShare Wisconsin Policy Handbook sections, up to 4 decimal levels (e.g. 3.17.1, 8.1.1.3)

fshsection.note: expedited service at application — federal-standard criteria ($150/$100), 7-day issuance
certification periods — 12-month standard range, 6-month homeless/migrant, 36-month EBD-no-earned-income
ABAWD work requirements — fixed 1/1/25-12/31/27 clock; handbook text NOT yet updated for OBBBA 18-64 age band (stale as of Release 26-01)
drug-related felonies — 5-year lookback, one-time drug test, 12-month sanction on failure
categorical and broad-based categorical eligibility — 200% flat BBCE via Job Center of Wisconsin notice; EBD no-gross-limit exception
medical expenses deduction — actual costs above $35, no flat standard amount found
support payment deductions — legally obligated/court-ordered child support, ordinary deduction not exclusion
shelter/utility deductions overview — 7-tier utility allowance ladder qualification conditions
income and asset limits — includes 8.1.1.3 asset limits ($3,000/$4,500)
deductions dollar tables — standard deduction, utility allowance dollar figures, shelter cap
